answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with a bonded stake and slashing: each new identity must lock real value on a shared terrace before it may vote. Splitting one wallet into a thousand fake lotus accounts buys no extra influence, because voting weight tracks stake rather than headcount, so every fake node merely divides the same deposit. A detected double-vote triggers slashing, and the ripple is that the forfeited bond pays honest validators, making forged identities cost more than any gain.
